objective: Select the earliest native-General residual dose that shows held-out General mechanism improvement while preserving all eight non-General parent tasks.

formal_training.checkpoint_selection_order: ascending optimizer step; stop at the first complete pass

general_target_gate.asset_role: permanent E diagnostic and checkpoint selection only; never training
general_target_gate.method: teacher-forced single A-D answer token after the canonical empty-think prefix; no generation and no sampling
general_target_gate.warning: This 23-row cohort is mostly math/logic and can reject a checkpoint, but passing does not establish broad online world gain.

retention_gate.asset_role: prompt-task-disjoint D holdout; checkpoint preservation only; never training
retention_gate.method: teacher-forced reference-vs-candidate logits on up to 128 uniformly spaced full assistant-target positions per row; KL is forward KL(reference||candidate)

structure_gate.method: reuse the frozen 60-row four-domain itemic structural probe with identical renderer and decoding

decision.select: the first candidate step in [32,64,96,129] that passes every General, retention, and structure threshold
decision.if_none_pass: close this native-General replay branch; do not package, upload, rescale, continue training, or relax a threshold
decision.packaging_if_pass: exactly concatenate s800 r80 and the selected scale-1 r8 residual into one r88/alpha88 adapter; disclose parameter concatenation lineage
